name: Armor Set (Codex)
description:
One command makes a whole player armor set from one brief (projects/

/authoring/armor-sets/.json): Codex paints the body, the woman's chest, helm and shoulder sheets in one gen-set manifest, then import + measured gates (holes on the body's real UVs, cut-out free edges, texels/m) + match-material, the page bakes, one item per slot per tier with icons, and a review sheet. A failing gate keeps the stage and installs nothing. CLI: apps/playground/tools/armor.mts; docs/armor-sets.md (One command).

options.label: Gen dry run (manifest + prompts, no Codex)
Run: lint -> gen -> import -> bake -> items -> review

set.label: Set id (blank = every brief for status)
